name: Tridev InfraEstates Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Tridev Infraestates Ltd manufactures and trades in paper products and provides financial services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TIEL is engaged in trading in shares, financial services, and investment activities, and has diversified into multiple segments, including third-party product distribution, unsecured personal loans, and corporate loans.

cons: Company has a low return on equity of -14.8% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 56.2% of their holding.
